next.reason: Order kept: sense the break, control footings minor up and headings major down to the break level, then detail or summary (§2023:14.9.16.4 GR5 'each control footing and control heading is printed, if defined, up to the level of the control break'; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR2; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR3; §2023:13.18.16.4 GR3 equality test). Changed: 1985 a.1 gives the prior control values only to 'the control footing USE procedures and control footing SOURCE clauses', and 1985 XIII.3.20.4 GR13c gives every other report-group reference the current values. 2023 §2023:13.18.16.4 GR4 a): 'If the printing of the control footing causes a page advance and the page heading or page footing refers to a control data item, the value produced is similarly the prior value.' A 1985 page footing SOURCE naming a control item prints a different value when a control footing forces the page advance.
